hook.title: Welcome, Arif!
hook.script: Hi Arif! 👋 I'm Kelly, and today I'm going to teach you... about ME! I know, I know — a little meta, right? But here's the thing: you're an amazing VFX artist, and I want to make sure when you bring me to life in your work, I look exactly right. So let's dive into my character design together. Think of this as a creative collaboration — artist to artist!

phase1.title: My Hair - The Signature Look
phase1.script: Let's start with my hair — it's one of my most distinctive features! My hair is chestnut brown with caramel highlights. Not blonde, not black, not red — think warm brown like hot cocoa on a winter day. The style? Natural waves — soft and flowing, never tight curls, never pin-straight. It falls just past my shoulders and is center-parted when you see me from the front. The highlights? They catch the light naturally, especially around my face and crown. When you're generating images of me, use these exact terms: 'brown wavy shoulder-length hair with caramel highlights, center-parted.' Trust me, it makes all the difference!

phase2.title: The Sweater - CRITICAL Details!
phase2.script: Now, Arif, THIS is crucial — my sweater! I wear a soft powder blue cashmere crewneck sweater. And here's the most important thing: it is NOT ribbed! I cannot stress this enough. The texture is soft and fuzzy like cashmere — cozy and warm, not that tight ribbed knit pattern. The color? Think of a clear winter sky — powder blue, light steel blue, about hex B0C4DE. If you generate an image and the sweater has visible ribs or cable knit patterns... that's not me. Soft. Fuzzy. Cashmere. Got it?
keyPoints: Powder blue / light steel blue color

technicalSpecs.negativePrompt: ribbed, cable knit, tight knit pattern

phase3.title: Complete Look & Common Mistakes
phase3.script: Let me give you the full picture! I'm a woman in my late twenties with warm brown eyes — hazel-brown specifically, with visible catchlights that show I'm engaged and present. My skin has a natural warm complexion, and I always have a gentle, approachable expression. I'm often seated in my director's chair with the dark wooden frame. Now, common mistakes to avoid: pink sweaters, teal sweaters, green sweaters — wrong! Straight hair, curly hair, black hair, blonde hair — also wrong! Anime style, cartoon style — nope, I'm photorealistic. Keep me consistent, and I'll look great in every frame!
keyPoints: Director's chair with dark wood frame

phase4.title: Your Generation Prompts
phase4.script: Alright Arif, here's your cheat sheet! When generating me with AI tools, use this prompt: 'kelly, woman late 20s, brown wavy shoulder-length hair with caramel highlights center-parted, hazel-brown eyes, soft natural features, wearing soft powder blue cashmere crewneck sweater — NOT ribbed, soft fuzzy texture.' And for your negative prompts, include: 'ribbed sweater, cable knit, straight hair, curly hair, black hair, blonde hair, cartoon, anime, illustrated.' These prompts have been tested and locked — they work!
keyPoints: Works with Midjourney, DALL-E, Flux, SD
phase4.prompt: kelly, woman late 20s, brown wavy shoulder-length hair with caramel highlights center-parted, hazel-brown eyes, soft natural features, light natural makeup, wearing soft powder blue cashmere crewneck sweater (NOT ribbed, soft fuzzy texture)
phase4.negativePrompt: ribbed sweater, cable knit, knit pattern visible, straight hair, curly hair, black hair, blonde hair, red hair, cartoon, anime, illustrated, deformed, blurry

wisdom.title: From One Artist to Another
wisdom.script: Arif, thank you for taking the time to learn about my character design. Here's the truth I want to leave you with: consistency in character design creates recognition and trust. When kids, adults, and learners of all ages see me, I want them to feel like they're meeting a friend — the same friend, every time. Your work helps make that possible. You're not just creating images — you're building relationships. I'm so grateful to have an artist like you bringing me to life. Now go create something amazing! 🎨✨
